page.overview:
What is Gro'tye?

The Gro'tye [Pronounced Gro'tE] are incredibly powerful creatures native to LV-742. They appear in Aliens versus Predator: Extinction.

The Gro'Tye is an extremely large creature, much larger than a full-grown and far more powerful in terms of brute strength. It can even survive a prolonged assault by a fully armed group of Yautja, as well as send them flying away simultaneously with one sweeping blow. They are able to detect them despite their cloaking devices. It is assumed to be predatory because its dwellings are filled with the skeletons of other animals, it can rear up on two legs to attack or survey its surroundings, but it is primarily quadrupedal. Gro'tye are very durable creatures, able to survive a sustained attack by several groups of hunters before succumbing.

The legend of the Gro'Tye chronicles the plight of countless Yautja clans who, over the ages, have met their death in fierce bloodsport. It recounts how entire clans were annihilated by a single Gro'Tye, and how a pack of Gro'Tye slaughtered even the strongest of clans.

Two clans of Yautja were granted "exclusive hunting rights" to the planet LV-742, and both as a test by the Council of Ancients to determine the superior clan. The two clans first came to blows during one of the clans hunt for the Gro'Tye, each thinking the other was a poacher,. The winning clan, the Ancient's Succesors, not only managed to defeat their rivals, but defeat three of the fearsome beasts and take their skulls.
